description: Get the latest market-wide news across ALL tickers, most recent first. Every item is significance-classified at ingest (critical | major | standard); the default filter of critical,major is the "top stories" view. Use for "what is happening in the market right now" — for news about one company, use get_news with a ticker instead. Requires the /news/latest public endpoint (added 2026-07-29; 404 until that backend deploy).

limit.description: Maximum items to return (1-50). Defaults to 10.

significance.description: CSV of levels to include, e.g. "critical,major" (default) or "critical,major,standard".

name: get_market_news
title: Get Market News (Top Stories)
